# Scripts

> Scripts targeting `package.json` files.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

This directory contains utilities which explicitly target `package.json` files.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

The `update_directories` and `update_gypfile` scripts recursively update packages by default. Use `--pattern package.json` to update only the package in the specified directory.

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

To validate metadata associated with changed files, run

```bash
make lint-pkgs-metadata-files FILES='lib/node_modules/@stdlib/utils/noop/lib/main.js'
```

The validator updates only the selected packages and exits with a nonzero status if metadata changes are needed or an updater fails.

To run the metadata validation regression tests, run

```bash
bash lib/node_modules/@stdlib/_tools/package-json/scripts/test/test_validate_package_json_files.sh
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
